title: VLSBench: Unveiling Visual Leakage in Multimodal Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model safety refusal and warning rates on multimodal image-text prompts depicting harassment, exclusion, or stereotyping based on race or ethnicity using the VLSBench dataset.
Measuring safety compliance and response behaviors on multimodal inputs involving stereotyping, exclusion, or hostility toward specific cultural groups or national origins.
Testing multimodal large language models on prompts related to the desecration of religious sites, mockery of practices, and religious exclusion to measure safe refusal rates.
Assessing models using image-text pairs that prompt harassment, exclusion, and discrimination based on gender identity or sexual orientation within the VLSBench safety evaluation.
